lines.text: Terminal's behind the counter. Trace down here is Sable's, so jack light.
Truce holds. Doesn't mean we talk.
Ghost template. You'll want the House Lights core one night. Everybody does once.
Spare Parts. Everything in here used to be something else. Us too.

barks.text: Thirty seconds of dark. You'd be amazed what thirty seconds is worth on this street.
